mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room ( user_no, admin_no, status, category, created_date ) VALUES ( #{userNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{adminNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'OPEN', #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT room_no, user_no, admin_no, status, category, last_message, last_message_date, created_date, closed_date FROM chat_room WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY created_date DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT room_no, user_no, admin_no, status, category, last_message, last_message_date, created_date, closed_date FROM chat_room WHERE room_no = #{roomNo}

SELECT room_no, user_no, admin_no, status, category, last_message, last_message_date, created_date, closed_date FROM chat_room ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 1 WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, last_message_date DESC NULLS LAST, created_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_message = #{lastMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_message_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE room_no = #{roomNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
UPDATE chat_room SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE room_no = #{roomNo}
